column1:
Things to keep in mind when using this framework
• These statements describe key aspects of what's expected for the role and level, but should not be considered comprehensive and should not be used as a checklist exercise. You should always aim to create impact at Vinted and acting in line with the statements above should help you do that—but the statements should never become the goal.
• Discussions should consider the dimension as a whole (e.g. "Scope & Complexity"), rather than just the sub-dimensions listed here. There will be many cases where creating impact in a particular position may involve more than what's listed here—and this should always be considered when discussing opportunities to grow and create more impact.
• Statements are additive from left to right—e.g. an IC3 would typically be expected to act in line with the statements under IC1 and IC2 even though they are not explicitly mentioned under IC3.
• Clarification on the definition of scope used in this document: "within the capability function / area / domain" etc. is always fixed and is explained in the definitions table below, for more unique cases "in my scope" is used, and scope increases with level and is different for every role and level.
